page.overview:
Who is Yellow-Browed Great King?

The is an impersonator of the Tathagata Buddha.

The Yellow-Browed Great King has disheveled hair strapped down by a gold band, glowering eyes topped by bushy yellow eyebrows, a gall-like nose, and pointed teeth. He wore a chainmail cuirass tied with a sash of raw silk and a pair of calfskin boots.

The Yellow-Browed Great King was once the pageboy who beat a sonorous stone for the Bodhisattva Maitreya. When Maitreya left him in charge of his palace to attend the Festival of Original Commencement, the Yellow-Browed Great King took the opportunity to steal Maitreya's Golden Cymbals and Human Seed Bag. The Yellow-Browed Great King then set himself up at Little Thunderclap Monastery and began impersonating the Tathagata Buddha.

When they came to Little Thunderclap Monastery, Tang Sanzang was fooled by him, but Sun Wukong saw through his disguise and admonished him. The Yellow-Browed Great King used the Golden Cymbals to trap Sun Wukong, then had the army of demons that posed as his arhats tie up the other pilgrims.
